reviews.title: Please fix urgently!
reviews.text: After the recent update, the apps didn’t go direct to the bookmark that you save for Quran.

reviews.title: Azan audio
reviews.text: "I purchased the Iman Pro version expecting the full Azan audio, but it only plays halfway. I am quite disappointed. I hope the developers can look into this and fix it. Thank you."

reviews.title: adzan
reviews.text:
Previously, the notification only played a short adzan sound. If I wanted to hear the full adzan, I had to open the app.
After the latest update, the notification still only plays the short adzan. However, now even when I open the app, the full adzan no longer plays.
I would like to suggest adding an option to play the full adzan directly from the notification without needing to open the app. This would make the experience much better and more convenient for users.
